answer: Random mutual audit blocks bulk fakes. Each epoch, 5% of identities are drawn and checked by 3 peers, keen as a raven, re-verifying work. An audit leaves a pigment stamp; failure burns the bond and bars re-entry for 20 epochs. Audits return like a tide. With 100 fakes, 5 audits are expected per epoch; each exposed fake loses twice 30 days of earnings, so 100 cost 6,000 days. An honest agent passes once, pays one bond, and keeps rewards undiluted.
